struck: Most Horry County homes change hands in March through June.
use: From 2021 to 2025, about 38 percent of Horry County home resales were recorded in March through June, more than in any other four months in a row (an even spread is 33 percent).

struck: We counted 65,664 home resales recorded in Horry County from 2021 to 2025: 48,338 houses and townhomes and 17,326 condos.
use: We counted 65,664 home resales recorded in Horry County from 2021 to 2025: about 37,400 houses and townhomes and 28,300 condos.

struck: We left out 21,968 builders' sales of new homes, because a builder closes when a house is finished, not by season.
use: We left out 21,968 sales by builders, whose closings are spread more evenly over the year.

struck: From 2021 on, over 98 percent of deeds each month carry a parcel number.
use: The index carries a parcel number on nearly every deed only from July 2020.

struck: Houses that closed in February sold below in all five (about 3 percent).
use: February was about 2 percent below on average, below in three of five years.

struck: July was above in four years and level in the fifth.
use: July and September were higher in all five years too.

struck: Condos that closed in April and May sold for a middle price about 5 percent above the months around them, in four of five years.
use: Condos that closed in April and May sold for a middle price about 4 percent above the months around them, in four of five years.

struck: Builders' new homes show no price season.
use: (cut it: the data show a February dip for builders too)

struck: Zillow's average from contract to closing ran 36 to 42 days in every month, longest for January closings.
use: After a buyer signs, closing took about five weeks here: Zillow's monthly average from contract to sale ran 36 to 42 days.

struck: Houses sold for a middle price of $325,000 from January to October 2026, and condos $220,000.
use: From January to October 2026 it was $305,000, against $304,000 a year earlier, with about the same number of sales.

struck: July is the top month for short-term rental income in every beach market we track.
use: July is the top month for short-term rental income in all eight towns in our rental data, from Little River to Pawleys Island, inland Conway included.

struck: The tourist season is strongest in July, the month after the condo price peak.
use: Rentals earn the most in July, the month after houses here sell highest.

struck: Most storms come between mid-August and mid-October, with the peak on September 10.
use: Most of the season's activity comes between mid-August and mid-October, with the peak on September 10.

struck: Tropical Storm Debby came ashore at Bulls Bay early on Thursday, August 8, 2024.
use: The storm Debby came ashore near Bulls Bay early on Thursday, August 8, 2024.

struck: The last day of school is June 4, 2026, and the first day of the next year is August 19, 2026.
use: This school year ends June 8, 2027, and the next one starts August 18, 2027.

struck: If you owned and lived in the home for at least 2 of the last 5 years, you may leave up to $250,000 of gain out of income ($500,000 on a joint return).
use: If you owned the home and lived in it as your main home for at least 2 of the 5 years before the sale, you may be able to leave up to $250,000 of the gain out of your income, or $500,000 on a joint return when both spouses lived there 2 years.

struck: For a rental or second home, the gain is long-term only if you held it more than one year.
use: For a rental or second home you bought, the gain is generally long-term only if you held it more than one year; a gift or an inherited home follows other rules.
